highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.150.0 updates the engine to Skia m150 and expands filters and rendering diagnostics.
highlights_body: It adds paint bounds for quick-reject culling, overdraw visualization, and image filter factories, while improving blur and surface-canvas performance. This release also removes deprecated notebook integration and turns remaining pre-v4 obsoletes into compile errors.

breaking.title: Remaining pre-v4 obsoletes are compile errors
breaking.body: Calls to the remaining pre-v4 obsolete APIs now fail compilation, and SKPaintHinting and SKFilterQuality are absent from the reference assembly. Use the render-target constructors without sampleCount, run-buffer Glyphs and Positions properties, SKFontHinting, and SKSamplingOptions instead.

breaking.title: .NET Interactive integration removed
breaking.body: The SkiaSharp NuGet package no longer embeds the deprecated SkiaSharp.DotNet.Interactive extension. Consumers that depend on its Polyglot Notebooks rendering support must remove that dependency or provide their own notebook integration.

bullets.detail: Moves the bundled rendering engine from Skia m148 to m150 while retaining PDF support on Tizen.

bullets.lead: Fast paint bounds enable quick-reject culling
bullets.detail: SKPaint.GetFastBounds() computes conservative paint bounds that include path effects, strokes, mask filters, and image filters, making it safe to pair with SKCanvas.QuickReject().
SKColorFilter.CreateOverdraw() maps SKOverdrawCanvas draw counts through a six-color heat-map palette for rendering diagnostics.

bullets.lead: Image filter composition gains crop and empty nodes
bullets.detail: SKImageFilter.CreateCrop() restricts filter output with configurable tile modes, while CreateEmpty() supplies an explicit transparent-black node that discards its input.

bullets.lead: Small raster blurs recover their fast path
bullets.detail: Routes small-sigma 8888 image blurs away from the slow raster-pipeline Gaussian path across supported native builds.

bullets.lead: Apple typeface stream access is synchronized
bullets.detail: Updates the m150 engine with the upstream fix for concurrent CoreText typeface stream access on Apple platforms.
SKSurface caches and reuses its SKCanvas wrapper across calls, and obtains a fresh wrapper if the surface-owned canvas wrapper was explicitly disposed.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Pre-v4 obsolete API migration, faster small-sigma raster blurs, and cached SKSurface canvas access

v4.150.0-preview.1.1.summary: Updates the bundled rendering engine from Skia m148 to m150 while retaining PDF support on Tizen.

v4.150.0-preview.2.1.summary: Turns the remaining pre-v4 obsoletes into compile errors and removes the deprecated .NET Interactive extension. Updates bundled HarfBuzz to 14.2.1 with shaping, color-font, glyph-extents, and subsetting fixes.

v4.150.0-rc.1.1.summary: Adds fast paint bounds, overdraw visualization, and crop and empty image filter nodes. Restores fast small raster blurs, accelerates SKSurface.Canvas access, and fixes concurrent Apple typeface stream access.

harfbuzz_summary: Updates the bundled HarfBuzz from 14.2.0 to 14.2.1, with shaping, COLR v1, glyph-extents, and subsetting fixes.
